# Dialing in the grinder

Notes for the hand grinder and the new espresso machine.

- Start at 12 clicks for espresso, 18 g in, 36 g out, 28 to 32 seconds.
- Sour espresso: grind finer. Bitter espresso: grind coarser or lower the temperature.
- Light roasts need a finer espresso grind than dark roasts.
- Purge two grams after changing the setting.

Write the setting on the bag for every new espresso bean.
